title: Score a piece against the brand
summary: A score out of ten for one piece of writing, with what to change.
text: Score this piece against the brand file and the can't-say list: [piece]. Give a score out of 10 for tone, for clarity, for brand fit and for the first line, with one reason for each. List every phrase that is on the can't-say list, or say there are none. Then list the changes that would raise the lowest score. Do not rewrite the piece itself.
